value.main_text_excerpt:
Main Areas:
Market Access Strategies and Policy/Governmental Affairs
Nordic Countries primarily with strongest in-depth knowledge for Norway.
Examples of focus and deliveries:
HTA strategies, tender strategies, landscape overviews, market events and launch planning and execution.
Particular focus has been on governmental affairs and market access work for patient access to gene therapies, rare diseases and personalized medicines, but also advised companies within the primary care reimbursement schemes and for broader hospital access in misc. types of cancers across the Nordics.
Implementing such projects either as a single consultant or with strategic partners (see "About" section for list of preferred partners).
Commercial Model incl. Customer Dialogue with Health Care Professionals
Why, What and How
Working with Leadership teams on digital strategy, help to prioritize, focus on capabilities and drive change.
Working with Digital teams and Brand teams locally and above market on strategies, marketing mix and execution.
Help driving digital transformation of the business models.
Drive processes for above country vs within country roles and solutions.
Advise on compliance regulations per Nordic market.
Knowledge Center for Pharmaceutical- and Health Care Industry in the Nordic countries.
Helping start-ups on commercial strategy.
Connecting experts and stakeholders.
Mentorship for a SPARK research project at University of Oslo which became a start-up company in 2023 (Klyv Therapeutics) where I am co-founder and has served as chairman of the board and board member.
In-depth analysis for market segment opportunities on behalf of larger or smaller corporations with focus on the Nordic countries.
Leading change with previous hands on experience from leading a large merger and driving digital transformation.
Market and Customer understanding. (incl. work with preferred partners within market research / customer insights/HTA)
Tailored Solutions to the need of the organization
Based on broad leadership experience and often in collaboration with a network of selected subject matter experts (see "About" section).
Management for hire
If requested, typically 3-9 months based on need. Most recent experience from 2021 and from 2023 as Acting Nordic Lead of two different and non competing US /EU based pharmaceutical company that had no previous focus on the Nordic region. Tailormade Consulting can be a strong, first "bridgehead" into the Nordic countries and help build what is needed for successful launches of pharmaceuticals approved by EMA.
For more details, see the "about" and "services" section.

pages.title: About - TAILORMADE CONSULTING
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Mission and purpose: Helping patients have access to medical innovations in the Nordic Countries 
This mission translates into many different projects and support:
Involvement in innovation projects, involvement in market access and policy work, involvement with PAGs, involvement with key stakeholders, involvement in leadership teams and change management to mirror the digital world around us, involvement in building capabilities, involvement in strategy work...
All executed in a tailored manner to support the customer and the mission.
			
Andreas Berg
Managing Director and Owner
Tailormade Consulting AS was started in March 2018 and I have since then successfully helped several companies in the Nordic region:
- Startup companies and a research projects in SPARK at UiO on commercial strategy
- Existing "Big Pharma" companies on Market Access strategy, Landscape analysis in a Therapeutic Area (incl. vaccines), Preparing for tenders, Governmental Affairs and Policy work for Gene-based therapies etc
- Driving Digital Strategy, Execution and Change Management for Nordic subsidiaries
- Helping smaller Biotech / Life Science companies new to the Nordic region incl. taking the role as acting Nordic General Manager for a specified time period.
Deliveries alone or in partnership with others ?
I do both and have established a strong network of preferred partners;
- Some preferred partners:
NordiMED for Market Research in the Nordic markets.
Wickstrøm & Langkilde (WL Pharma) and also NHTA, both based in Denmark for Nordic reimbursement submissions.
Link Medical for CRO help incl. needs for regulatory, compliance or quality support.
Teriak AS in areas where we see complementary competencies.
I also collaborate with other independent health advisors/consultants in other Nordic markets.
I will of course provide further details upon request.
I thrive in this variation of fascinating consulting opportunities.
Client list (since the start in 2018):
Amarin Corporation, Sarepta Therapeutics, Menarini Stemline, Gilead Nordics, Sobi, Oslo Cancer Cluster / Connect Norway, Regeneron BV, Amgen Norway, Merck Norway, Novartis Norway, Avexxis Nordic, Pfizer Norway, Roche Norway, Boehringer Ingelheim, Norway, Corticalis AS, Galapagos Nordic, Mundipharma Norway, Eisai AB, Gullers Group AB, Santhera UK
Selected project support to other, larger consultancy companies like: Rud Pedersen Norway, CRAI, Athenum, Syneos Health, IQVIA, FTI, Fiecon, Guidepoint.
Highlights from my CV:
Prior to Tailormade Consulting AS, I was Managing Director in MSD Norway for 4,5 years, Nordic Business Portfolio Lead for 4 years and have also worked at Global Headquarters, European Headquarters and in other Nordic roles in MSD.
I have been an elected member of the board of the American Chamber of Commerce (Amcham) in Norway since 2011 and was last re-elected for another 3 years in 2026.
CV-Journey
Master of Science (Siviløkonom) from the Norwegian School of Economics (NHH) in Bergen 1990
After my business studies, I started the unusual journey of a long career within one company; Merck, Sharpe & Dohme (MSD)
- Medical sales rep for 2,5 years in Mid-Norway
- Product Manager
- Sales Manager
- Business Unit Manager and later Business Unit Director
All this in MSD Norway before
- 3 years at Merck & co Inc (MSD) global headquarter in New Jersey, USA;
European Marketing Director, CVD covering Europe, Middle East, Africa and Canada from 2001-04
- Returned as Business Director, Norway
- Nordic Marketing Director for new products
- Worked one year as European Marketing Operations Lead at the
European Regional Business Team in Munich, Germany until Nov 2009
- Managing Director (MD) MSD Norway Nov 2009 - February 2014.
Started as a MD on day one of a global merger. Hence I was leading the merger between MSD, Schering-Plough and Organon in Norway. With HR, Finance and a Local Integration committee with members of the 3 previous leadership teams, we focused on building a new culture, finding a new and modern venue for the new company, developing talents and give current talents new opportunities in a new company. We worked hard to find the right size and fit for the new company and moved fast, but respectfully with the needed down-sizing.
- Elected member of the board and later chairman of board of LMI (Norwegian Pharma association) 2010-14
- Elected member of the board and also a period as vice chair to the board of Amcham Norway (2013-present)
- Built and lead a Nordic Digital and Marketing team that secured a common digital Eco-system in MSD as Nordic & Baltic Business Portfolio Lead 2014-2018
Started Tailormade Consulting AS March 2018
Other experiences relevant for Tailormade Consulting AS
- MSD Fellow at CEDPA India (now C3), a not for profit company focusing on women rights, gender equality and sexual education, planned parenthood and reduced maternal mortality in India.
I worked 3 months for CEDPA in New Dehli and other parts of India to help build their 5 years busin
